rules.behavior: When starting from a cover whose original is not already known, always ATTEMPT original identification in background without blocking search/cards/player. Original means the performer of the FIRST PUBLISHED VERSION of the same song. Start from the selected published recording; use available metadata and documented links across multiple sources, not COVER.INFO alone. AI can propose a candidate if links/data are insufficient; its answer alone is not evidence. Verify that the candidate is linked to the same work and is the first published version through documented corroboration; ONE reliable explicit corroboration can suffice. Identifying only the work or finding the earliest item in an incomplete catalog does not automatically prove the first published performer. An equal title alone is only a clue because of homonyms. A reverse lookup from proposed original to the starting cover may strengthen confirmation but is not an obligatory second check. If original identification fails, remains uncertain or is slow, continue with available selected-version information, retaining results/candidates and allowing background enrichment. Never label the selected cover singer or the AI hypothesis as confirmed original without verification. Verified original context improves finding/recognizing other covers; its absence is never a new admission condition.
